text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "『Triumphant songs resound. Flower petals dance in the air. Along the sparkling road to glory—』"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: “Behold, the Hero Marches On”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I want to be a hero from a story.
I was very young the first time I thought that.)

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Mom! The main character of this story... has the exact same name as me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. You've reached the age where you can read
'Rob Roy' too, Rob Roy-chan. Is it interesting?"

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even when things are painful, even if it looks ungraceful, fighting over and over again without giving up... That's so cool...

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Can I become like this too, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu, let's see... If you read all the books on Mommy's bookshelf, you might find out how, you know?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Perhaps it was merely a convenient pretext
concocted by my mother—an author and avid reader—
to get me to read books.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (A hero who lost everything, yet gritted their teeth and stood back up for those they loved—seeing that gave me so much courage.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I wept at the hero
who threw himself onto the battlefield,
casting aside even his own life for the sake of a single love.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I watched in longing as the hero chased an endless dream,
single-mindedly leaving everything behind.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I devoured countless books.
Researching and researching how I could become a hero too... and then, I realized.)

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm not good enough……

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I've never been looked up to by anyone,
never moved anyone's heart,
and never inspired anyone with courage."

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, I don't have the courage...
to create such a "story"...

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so shy, and I never stand out.
In the first place, having the courage to try and stand out...
to become the protagonist and weave a story, I just don't...

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Mom, I... can't become a hero.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (That's true. That's what I thought. ...However...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Community Exchange Chibi Umamusume Race!
This year's winner is...
First-time runner, Zenno Rob Roy-chan--!!

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (It happened at a race for children—not that I gathered my courage to join, but simply because I lacked the courage to refuse the invitation.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Exhausted, I casually looked up.
Waiting there for me was—roaring applause and pure fervor.)
(Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hyah...!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-chan, congratulations!
Everyone's so hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah, ...I-It's true.
What incredible... excitement...

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone... is looking at me...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible run!
Is your future dream to make your mark
in the Twinkle Series, after all?

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —A hero...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah, no!
It's... nothing! Nothing at—

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, could it be?
Could it be that here—
in races, I could actually become a hero?

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If it's here... even I
could become the protagonist of a story...!

text_block_list.name: Young Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to become one!
Even I, someday—!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (—I want to become a hero.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...That single thought was where everything began.
The prologue of prologues, the story before the first chapter.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...How does that sound for an opening line!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Let's see, after this, I enroll in Tracen Academy, and...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
After the part where I flounder around, feeling rushed by how strong everyone else is,
I finally get to meet Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "The Tale of Zenno Rob Roy's Heroism"...?
choice_data_list: This is the one I want to read!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh— Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'll do my best. So much so that you'll want to pass down the story we make from here on.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Together, we will surely bring it to completion.
The 'Heroic Tale of Zenno Rob Roy'...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...It's truly starting, isn't it?
Our Twinkle Series, that is."
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's make it a good story.
Yeah. Let's make it a great story.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that case... in order to do that... first,
I have to work hard to stand out a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A hero achieves great feats and captures everyone's attention! I usually tend to blend into the background... but overcoming that is important too, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Step by small step, steadily... For example, first, making sure I stand out during training—!

I can feel Zenno Rob Roy, who is naturally shy and hates standing out,
working hard to overcome her weaknesses...!

Zenno Rob Roy has finally taken her first step
toward her debut in the Twinkle Series.
Let us walk forward powerfully together...!
(SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Regarding Zenno Rob Roy's
training track reservation,
we overlooked the filing...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ......Wh-What?!

...In the end, we suddenly had to share the track
with other Umamusume for joint training
that day.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Be intoxicated by me!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I will fulfill my duty.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you for cheering for me again today!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~! Senpaaai!!" || "Kyaa~! Big brooother!!" -> "Kyaa~! Senpaaai!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I can't lose, I have to stand out too...! I... I have to, as well.........

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaa~h!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh...!!
—It seems the road to my dream is still a long way off.

"Even so, let us take it one step at a time.
For our heroic tale has already begun!"
